newsitem.title: GERMANY: German 1996 federal deficit to total 73 bln DM.
newsitem.headline: German 1996 federal deficit to total 73 bln DM.

text.p: Germany's federal budget deficit will total around 73 billion marks in 1996, compared with an original budget target of 59 billion marks, Adolf Roth, parliamentary budget spokesman of the Christian Democrats, said.
In the parliamentary lower house budget committee late Thursday, Finance Minister Theo Waigel said the 73 billion mark figure was the best estimate reflecting current conditions, Roth said.
